title: Add WhatsApp chat CTA and update site contact details

requirements.summary: Replace placeholder phone and existing email text in the consultation/contact section with the provided phone number and email address.
acceptanceCriteria: In the consultation section contact cards, the phone number is shown as "+91 8780410844" (no placeholders like "+91 XXX XXX XXXX").
In the consultation section contact cards, the email is shown as "freelancingdurg@gmail.com" (replacing any existing email such as "hello@webraft.in").
All user-facing text remains in English.

file_operations.description: Update the consultation contact cards to display phone "+91 8780410844" and email "freelancingdurg@gmail.com" (replacing placeholders). Prefer making these actionable via standard tel: and mailto: links while keeping the UI composed from existing shadcn-ui Card primitives—verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a visible WhatsApp CTA button that opens a direct WhatsApp chat to 918780410844 via a standard deep link.
acceptanceCriteria: A visible WhatsApp button exists on the site and is clearly labeled for WhatsApp chat.
Clicking the WhatsApp button opens a WhatsApp chat link targeting phone number "918780410844" (e.g., https://wa.me/918780410844).
The link opens in a new tab/window (or otherwise does not break the current browsing session) and works on both desktop and mobile browsers.

file_operations.description: Create a reusable WhatsApp CTA component that renders a clearly-labeled button linking to https://wa.me/918780410844 with target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer". Compose with existing shadcn-ui Button (and optional lucide icon) without editing ui component source—verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the global WhatsApp CTA into the app shell so it is visible site-wide (e.g., rendered alongside header/main/footer layout). Ensure it opens the wa.me link in a new tab and does not interfere with page switching—verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make the WhatsApp contact area in the consultation/contact section clickable and linked to the direct WhatsApp chat URL for 918780410844.
acceptanceCriteria: The WhatsApp card/row in the consultation section is clickable (or contains a button/link) that opens https://wa.me/918780410844.
No backend changes are required for this interaction.

file_operations.description: Update the WhatsApp contact card/row to be actionable (wrap card content with an anchor or add a clear link/button) pointing to https://wa.me/918780410844, opening in a new tab with proper rel attributes. Keep implementation frontend-only and composed using existing shadcn-ui Card/Button—verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update the footer contact area to show the provided phone number and email address, optionally including a WhatsApp chat link.
acceptanceCriteria: If a WhatsApp link is included in the footer, it points to https://wa.me/918780410844.

file_operations.description: Update the footer Contact section content to include phone "+91 8780410844" and email "freelancingdurg@gmail.com" (prefer tel:/mailto: links). Optionally add a WhatsApp chat link pointing to https://wa.me/918780410844 that opens in a new tab. Keep all user-facing text in English and avoid backend calls—verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
